content:
CPython 3.13’s experimental free-threading configuration lets an application run with the GIL disabled. But importing an extension can change that runtime state.

If an extension has not explicitly declared support for free threading, CPython emits a warning and enables the GIL. How the declaration is made depends on whether the extension uses multi-phase or single-phase initialization.

That declaration signals compatibility with the mode; it does not make the extension’s code thread-safe. For extension authors, declaring support and ensuring thread safety are separate responsibilities.
